description: Held-out NL2SQL generalization benchmark. Unlike nl2sql_execution_benchmark.json, the questions here are deliberately paraphrased away from the literal phrasings used elsewhere (e.g. '会引起身体哪些不适' instead of '有哪些症状', '需要服用哪些药物' instead of '用什么药', '要做哪些化验检测' instead of '做什么检查'). The translator-generated SQL is executed against the embedded graph and its rows are compared (order-independent) with a hand-written gold query. This measures whether the entity-aware keyword translator generalizes to unseen surface forms, not just the exact training phrasings. Known boundary: a question with zero lexical overlap with any intent keyword falls back to entity_distribution; the fine-tuned local NL2SQL model is the path to cover those.

cases.question: 高血压会引起身体哪些不适
cases.gold_sql: SELECT t.name AS symptom FROM edges e JOIN nodes s ON e.source = s.id JOIN nodes t ON e.target = t.id WHERE e.predicate = 'has_symptom' AND s.name = '高血压' ORDER BY symptom ASC LIMIT 20
